title: Beyond Training for Cultural Awareness: The Role of Dataset Linguistic Structure in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper evaluates models on benchmarks covering three categories: cultural knowledge, cultural values, and cultural norms. It does not specify any measurement related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not provide any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the relationship between the linguistic properties of datasets and general cultural alignment.
